task: Fix review_run_start clean-tree preflight ordering so blocking dirty-tree checks run before review snapshot capture.
outcome: review_run_start refuses blocking material-source dirty trees before captureReviewRunSnapshot can create or validate a reviewer snapshot; unreadable git-status remains fail-open and then snapshot handling keeps its own diagnostics.
facts: B-7691 added a material-source clean-tree preflight to review_run_start, but the handler ordering placed captureReviewRunSnapshot before the preflight.
The intended policy is a pre-snapshot refusal gate for blocking dirty material-source changes, not a post-snapshot abort.
The existing dirty-worktree classifier and DIRTY_GATE_POLICY already encode the refusal policy and should be reused unchanged.
The targeted regression belongs in packages/main/src/tasks/review-run-clean-tree-preflight-smoke.ts because that smoke owns the review_run_start clean-tree preflight surface.
constraints: Move the existing preflight block without changing dirty classification, material hash computation, DONE gate behavior, or evidence freshness policy.
Keep the ordering test deterministic and end-to-end through the CLI handler.
Preserve existing review-run workspace diagnostics where they are not directly contradicted by the pre-snapshot dirty-tree refusal policy.
